items.q: What is a forward deployed engineer?
items.a: A **customer-facing software engineer** who makes an AI product **deliver an outcome** inside the customer's systems.
Base about **$180-275k**, median total pay about **$230k**.
About two thirds involve **25-50% travel** and heavy **stakeholder work**.

items.q: Which skill appears in about 80% of FDE postings?
items.a: **Scoping and discovery** with stakeholders and executives.
Because **a demo doesn't prove it works; evals do**.

items.q: How can you practise discovery cheaply?
items.a: Have Claude **role-play a frustrated VP of operations** and grade your questions.

items.q: What goes in a one-page scope?
items.a: The problem in the **customer's words**, **the one number you'll move**, what done means and what's **out of scope**.
**One real end-to-end project** written up as a **before/after case study**.
